Test.Text: create view AM.vMeasureValues as select MeasureId, ValueIndex, MeasureValue = convert( float, MeasureValue )/10, MeasureValueUncumulated = convert( float, first_value(MeasureValue) over ( partition by MeasureId order by ValueIndex ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) )/10 from AM.tMeasureValues;
